title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for diabetes and renal function.

HPI
The patient is a 62-year-old male presenting for a routine follow-up of type 2 diabetes mellitus and chronic kidney disease stage 4. He reports feeling generally well and denies any acute symptoms or recent changes in his renal status. He has been managed on an oral hypoglycemic for several years. He reports consistent adherence to his current medication regimen and denies any significant side effects.

Medication List
Metformin 500mg daily.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented x3. He appears in no acute distress. Vital signs are stable. Cardiovascular exam reveals regular rate and rhythm. Respiratory exam shows clear lungs to auscultation. Skin is intact without lesions.

Assessment
1. Type 2 diabetes mellitus
2. Chronic kidney disease stage 4

Plan
Continue current oral hypoglycemic. Monitor renal function and electrolytes. Follow up in three months for a repeat laboratory evaluation and clinical review.
explanations: CKD is listed under 'with' for diabetes in the Index, so the link is presumed: use the combination code E11.22.
Code also the CKD stage (N18.4) as instructed at the diabetes CKD code or separately when unrelated.
Long-term oral hypoglycemic use: add Z79.84.

distractors.why: The provider does not have to write 'due to'; 'with' presumes the link.
E11.2 is a subcategory; a 5th character is required.
The stage of CKD must be reported with N18.-.
Z79.84 captures long-term oral hypoglycemic use.
